sources.read_level: Official PDF introduction/methods and selected recommendation sections through browser; local text-layer size inspection across 16 pages; original PDF pages 3 and 5 visually inspected. No complete guideline evidence appraisal or finalized QA key claimed.
sources.supports: Document selection for oncology-nutrition PDF QA: sixteen pages, forty-three numbered recommendations, text/flowchart layout and source-grounded facts. Prior project source use means it is not an unseen-knowledge benchmark.
